किंग खान का ये चटपटा खुलासा हिला देगा आपका दिमाग! 🤯
मुंबई में Meta's House of Instagram 2026 इवेंट के दौरान शाहरुख खान ने Karan Johar से बातचीत में अपनी आने वाली फिल्म King को लेकर कई राज खोले। 🎬
शाहरुख खान ने बताया कि जब उन्होंने फिल्म इंडस्ट्री जॉइन की थी, तब उन्हें लगता था कि वे दिखने में अच्छे नहीं हैं, इसलिए हीरो बनना उनकी पर्सनल एम्बिशन बन गया था। 🕺
एक्टर ने एक पुराने रोमांटिक शूट का किस्सा शेयर करते हुए बताया कि उन्होंने अपनी को-स्टार से पूछ लिया था, 'क्या तुमने कल सुबह का मैथ होमवर्क खत्म कर लिया, बेटी?' 🤭
शाहरुख खान का कहना है कि एक्ट्रेसेस और उनके बीच उम्र का फासला इतना ज्यादा हो गया था कि उन्हें लगा अब उन्हें अपनी 61 साल की उम्र के हिसाब से रोल निभाने चाहिए। 👴
एक्टर ने बताया कि वे अपनी इस उत्सुकता को शांत करना चाहते थे कि क्या वे 60 साल की उम्र में भी हीरो बने रह सकते हैं और अपनी उम्र के हिसाब से किरदार निभा सकते हैं। 🤔
 Siddharth Anand के डायरेक्शन में बन रही फिल्म King दुनिया भर के सिनेमाघरों में 24 December 2026 को रिलीज़ होने के लिए शेड्यूल है। 🍿
क्या आप शाहरुख खान को इस नए अवतार में देखने के लिए तैयार हैं? नीचे कमेंट्स में बताओ! 👇

ctx.text:
Shah Rukh Khan has spent decades playing romantic leads and action heroes on screen. However, with his upcoming film King , the actor is also looking to explore a different aspect of his screen persona. Speaking at the launch of the film's second song, ‘ Daddy Cool (King Version)’ , at Meta's House of Instagram 2026 event in Mumbai, Khan explained that one of his motivations for taking up the project was to find out whether he could continue playing a hero while portraying characters closer to his actual age.
During his conversation with filmmaker Karan Johar at the event, SRK recalled that becoming a leading man had been a personal ambition since he entered the film industry. He said, "I did King because I always felt that I always wanted to be a hero. I'll tell you the reason, because when I joined the film industry, I felt that I was not good-looking. I thought that when I get a chance to be a hero, I just took it very personally. That someone who is so simple-looking as I am, can become a hero. So I hold it very dearly that I always have to play the hero."
The actor also spoke about an incident from a film shoot that made him reconsider the age difference between himself and the actresses he was paired with. Recalling a romantic scene without identifying the film or the people involved, he shared how the moment took an unexpected turn when he asked the actress, "And one more thing, did you finish your tomorrow morning's math homework, daughter?"
The incident made Khan reflect on the kind of roles he wanted to take up going forward. He said, "The age difference became so much between the girls I was acting with, that I started feeling I should play my age, which is 61, and be as cool as a 61-year-old can be. So even today, if I sit down or stand up and say any of the dialogues, it still seems relevant. Because my daughter Suhana is also in the film, all the girls in the world think, 'mera dad aisa bana tha'."
Explaining his curiosity behind King , he added, "So that's the reason for King . I just wanted to do it out of (curiosity). Am I still a hero at 60 and play my age?"
Directed by Siddharth Anand, King is scheduled to release in cinemas worldwide on December 24, 2026.
